source_articles.titre: OpenAI announces GPT-5 with specialized agentic capabilities
source_articles.texte: Today OpenAI announced its next generation frontier model GPT-5. The model features 500 billion active parameters and shows a 45% reduction in latency for complex coding workflows.

source_articles.titre: ECB cuts deposit facility rate by 25 basis points to 3.25 percent
source_articles.texte: The Governing Council of the ECB today decided to lower the deposit facility rate by 25 basis points to 3.25 percent, noting that disinflation is well on track across the euro area.

source_articles.titre: Major cyberattack impacts European energy & utility grid <infrastructure>
source_articles.texte: Security researchers detected sophisticated ransomware targeting regional energy providers in Central Europe. Over 120 substation controllers were temporarily disconnected.
